entries.zh: 饬令；下令、命令（上级差遣下属）
entries.en: to order, to command; to issue orders
entries.notes: L 栏「mandar en su ito confesaón」讹脱难读、R 栏缺，释义仅据 H 栏（飭令，另注勒令）与 M 栏定。

entries.zh: 挨推；互相推诿、彼此推托，把事情推给对方
entries.en: to push a matter back and forth; to shift responsibility onto one another; to order each other about

entries.zh: 官；官员（对中国朝廷命官的称呼）
entries.en: official; mandarin (a Chinese government official)

entries.zh: 丞；副贰之官（如县丞），或指丞相
entries.en: assistant or deputy official (e.g. a county vice-magistrate); (also) prime minister
entries.notes: L 栏仅作 mandarin，丞 可指丞相亦可指县丞，所指未能定。

entries.zh: 卿；朝廷重臣、大臣（对高官的称呼）
entries.en: high minister; minister of state (title for a high official)
entries.notes: L 栏作「mandarín, así llamado Rey」，与 卿 的对应关系不明，义存疑。

entries.zh: 老爹；对官员、长官的尊称
entries.en: lord, sir; honorific for an official or superior

entries.zh: 老爷；对官员、长官的尊称，亦泛指主人
entries.en: lord, master; honorific for a magistrate or one's superior

entries.zh: 官府；官署、衙门，亦指官府中人
entries.en: the magistrate's office; government authorities; yamen

entries.zh: 人臣；臣子、臣属（相对君主而言的官员）
entries.en: subject; minister (an official as the sovereign's servant)

entries.zh: 仕宦；为官、仕途，亦指仕宦之人
entries.en: official career; to serve in office; officials

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕老御官，疑为御前或资深之官
entries.en: obscure title lao-yu-guan; sense uncertain (text damaged)
entries.notes: H 栏用字存疑（御/爺），M 栏混入西文残句「500 son nomb~ de mandarín」，词义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 评事；大理寺评事，掌审议刑狱的官员
entries.en: assessor (ping-shi), a judicial official of the Grand Court of Review
entries.notes: L 栏称「近王之大官」，与 評事（大理寺属官、品秩不高）不合，且 M 栏有污损，义存疑。

entries.zh: 奸臣；欺君叛主的臣子
entries.en: treacherous minister; traitor to the king

entries.zh: 科道；科道官（六科给事中与各道御史），朝廷言官
entries.en: censorate officials (the Ke and Dao censors at court)

entries.zh: 布政司；承宣布政使司，一省民政财政长官及其衙署
entries.en: provincial administration commission; the provincial treasurer's office (Bu-zheng-si)

entries.zh: 三考；三次考绩（考满）之制，作者以小官释之
entries.en: the three-fold evaluation of officials; (glossed as) a lesser mandarin
entries.notes: 三考 本是考绩之制而非官名，与 L 栏「小官」的对应关系存疑。

entries.zh: 首领官；衙署首领官（经历、照磨、检校等佐贰杂职），作者以小官释之
entries.en: chief clerk of a yamen; subordinate administrative official (shou-ling-guan)

entries.zh: 照磨；掌核对案卷、审计文书的低级官员
entries.en: record-keeper and auditing clerk (zhao-mo), a minor office

entries.zh: 检校；掌校勘、检核文书案卷的低级官员
entries.en: document-checking official (jian-jiao); checker of official papers

entries.zh: 考试官；主持科举考试的考官
entries.en: examination official; examiner

entries.zh: 官吏；官员与胥吏（官长及其属吏）
entries.en: officials and their clerks; the magistrate and his staff
entries.notes: L 栏「compa el ofo」讹脱，释义据 H 栏（官吏）与 M 栏定。
